About Me

Hi, I'm Olamide, a customer support professional who believes the details matter.

I approach support as careful listening, understanding the real concern behind a request, and taking practical steps to move it forward. People should not have to repeat themselves or be left unsure what happens next.

My work across front-desk administration, university administration and remote tutoring has taught me to handle enquiries from many kinds of people, stay composed when concerns are raised, keep accurate records and coordinate with others when an issue needs a wider response. I ask focused questions, separate confirmed information from assumptions, and explain processes in plain language.

When an issue sits outside my authority, I document the details, route it to the right team and track the next step. Escalation should move an issue toward an answer while the customer knows what to expect.

What guides my work

EmpathyRecognise the concern without becoming defensive.
IntegrityShare verified information; avoid unsupported promises.
AccountabilityTrack the next action and close the loop.
ClarityMake updates and next steps easy to understand.
